title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland Season 2 Reveals Teaser Trailer, Fairouz Ai Joins Voice Cast
content: Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Animation revealed a teaser trailer for its second season, Episode of Savanaclaw , which will stream exclusively on Disney+ beginning in December 2026. Fairouz Ai has also joined the cast as Yuga Hirasaka.
author: Anime Corner

title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Reveals Episode 10 Preview
content: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA revealed the preview for Episode 10, titled “Sea”. Takumi Miyata ( Narenare: Cheer for you! ) is directing the episode with the script written by Tomomi Hitomi Ogawa ( The Apothecary Diaries ) and storyboard done by Tomomi Umetsu ( Food for the Soul ).
author: Anime Corner

title: 3 Compelling Reasons to Rewatch Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Now That It’s on Crunchyroll & Netflix
content: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle is now streaming on Crunchyroll and Netflix (in select regions), which means those who missed the film’s theatrical run can finally dive in. Of course, subscribers who have already seen the movie can also revisit it from the comfort of their own homes.
author: ComicBook

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Director Reveals Unblurred Image of Rem Scene From Episode 13
content: Re:ZERO Season 4 director Masahiro Shinohara revealed an original version of a scene from Episode 13 , featuring an unblurred image of Rem. The scene was shown on August 19 in the episode titled “Stand Up,” and Subaru’s tears were the reason for the initial blurriness.
author: Anime Corner

title: Naruto Teases Major Reveal For This Fall
content: It’s been years since anime fans last witnessed any adventures taking place within the Hidden Leaf Village. With the final episode of Boruto: Naruto Next Generations released in 2023, it’s been over three years since we last saw the works of Masashi Kishimoto brought to the screen.
author: ComicBook

title: Scholastic's Graphix Imprint to Offer 5 New Titles Based on Osamu Tezuka's Manga
content: Scholastic announced on Wednesday that it will release five new titles in partnership with Tezuka Productions under its Graphix imprint, and each one reimagines a manga by Osamu Tezuka . The titles to be reimagined are Atomcat / Astro Cat , Princess Knight , The Three-eyed One , Triton of the Sea and Zero Man .
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Removed Anime Confirms an Exciting Surprise After a Major Milestone
content: For almost a decade now, Crunchyroll has been the largest streaming hub for anime fans across the globe. The platform offers a huge plethora of anime series and films that can’t be found anywhere else. This not only includes several timeless classics but also dozens of Crunchyroll releases each quarter.
author: ComicBook

title: The Ghost in the Shell by Science SARU Releases Special PV Featuring New Image Song
content: The ongoing THE GHOST IN THE SHELL anime by Science SARU has released a special promotional video directed by Mokochan, featuring the newly released image song “po-ai feat. Mirai Moriyama.” The song was created by the anime’s music director Taisei Iwasaki and features vocals by actor Mirai Moriyama.
author: Anime Corner

title: Overgeared Anime's New Video Unveils More Cast, Theme Songs, October 2 Debut
content: The staff of Tempal: Item no Chikara (Tempal ~The Power of Items~), the television anime of South Korean webtoon studio REDICE STUDIO 's Overgeared webtoon, presented the anime's second promotional video, key visual, additional cast members, theme song artists, and October 2 premiere date on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: 38 Years Later, Studio Ghibli Shuts Down Any Hope of a My Neighbor Totoro Sequel
content: Studio Ghibli remains one of the most iconic animation studios of all time thanks to over a dozen timeless classics under its belt. Ever since its establishment in 1985, every film released under Ghibli’s banner has been praised for its stunning visuals and rich storytelling that deeply resonate with viewers of all…
